new: Places: a headset keeps a calibration per shared room and lines itself up in each one. In no room, or in a room it joined by itself, it joins the room whose tape crosses it stands at and says so; in a room you joined by hand it only offers it (Debug > Places). It never leaves a room it may still be standing in, and never rejoins a room you left on purpose.

Places: Anchors per room, two (the default, up to 4 rooms) or one (up to 8 rooms; 7 while Anchor is on), in Debug > Places, with Forget for each room. When a new room would pass that, the room used least recently is dropped, and a notice says which.

Studio, Stays on the floor: a switch among the recorder's rows (this device's own, off by default). A recording first sets the item down on the floor with its lowest side; from then on it only slides along the floor and turns about the vertical, whatever the hand or the arrows do. An empty or a sound keeps its height.

Controllers after standby: a controller the headset swaps without telling the page is now picked up at any time, not only within a minute of waking. A controller whose trigger press gets no click is noticed: that press is lost and logged, and its next presses are given as clicks until it works by itself again. One press never clicks twice.

Checking the crosses by eye: while the question shows, the two crosses glow and pulse, with a beam of light and a letter (A, B) over each. Under the question an arrow points to each with its distance (A 1.3 m), or a U-turn for one behind you.
test: Calibrate in two shared rooms, each with its own tape crosses. Leave AR, enter AR in the other room: it should join that room by itself, say so, line up and ask the check by eye. Debug > Places lists both rooms; Forget one.
Walk from one room to the other in one session (no leaving AR): does it switch, or only offer the room? Does it hold the room you are in when its anchors are slow?
Set Anchors per room to one, calibrate a room again, leave and come back: do the crosses sit on the tape (check by eye), and does the room stay put while you walk about?

Studio, editing on, a model on its card: Stays on the floor on, Record its movement, then carry it while lifting and tilting your hand. It should slide on the floor and play back the same way. On a page, the Turn arrows have no tilting rings.

After standby, or when a controller had gone to sleep: does the right controller click at once? If not, does the second press click? Tell me what the headset's log says (press missed, inputs replaced).
In AR in a shared room with spots: wake the headset; do the arrows lead you to the crosses, and do the beams and letters show across the room?
untested: Everything on a real headset: whether a Quest finds another room's anchors as you walk in mid-session or only when a session starts, how far apart rooms must be, and how a multi-room Space Setup behaves.
Whether a Quest's saved anchor keeps its turn exactly between sessions: one anchor per room rests on it (two stay the default).
Whether a Quest really drops presses after waking, and synthetic presses on a real Quest.
How carrying an item that stays on the floor feels life size, and the beams and arrows over a real room.
On dev only the quick checks ran (the lanes ran their own blocks); the full suites run before the main site moves.
